source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

concepts.label: Key-Value Data Operations (get/upsert/insert/replace/remove) via the Collection API
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - `doc get` / `GetAsync()` / `get()` and Sub-Document `lookupIn()`/`LookupInAsync()` are all instances of the same read operation family already documented in java-sdk/howtos/kv-operations.md.

concepts.label: Couchbase Shell (cbsh)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - already promoted; `doc get` and `doc get | get content.geo` are cbsh instances of the same access surface.

concepts.label: Document Expiration / TTL (expiry, preserveExpiry, getAndTouch)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - 'Reading with Options' demonstrates fetching expiry metadata via `options.Expiry()` / `GetOptions.getOptions().withExpiry(true)`, the same mechanism already documented in java-sdk/howtos/kv-operations.md.

concepts.label: Sub-Document Operations (lookupIn/mutateIn - path-level get/upsert/replace/remove within a document)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the established sdk:kv-operations concept (java-sdk/howtos/kv-operations.json) is explicitly scoped to whole-document 'get/upsert/insert/replace/remove'; it does not mention lookupIn/mutateIn or path-level access at all, so it doesn't cover this. This page's whole 'Reading a Sub-Document' section (LookupInAsync/lookupIn/LookUpInSpec) needs its own id. Recurs identically in deleting-data.md and updating-data.md, so this mint is shared across all three rather than re-minted per file.

relations.subject: sdk:kv-operations
relations.evidence: The [Key-Value (KV) or Data Service](../clusters/data-service/data-service.md) allows you to retrieve a full document when you need to fetch all of the data stored.

relations.subject: sdk:kv-operations
relations.evidence: Reading full documents to access a field or two is not ideal and could cause performance issues in your application. Instead, a better practice would be to access specific paths, or Sub-Documents, to perform more efficient read operations.

notable_absence.finding: No RBAC/privilege mention for the get/lookupIn operations, consistent with the other KV-operation guide pages in this batch.

cross_component_finding: The 'Reading a Sub-Document' section's guidance ('Reading full documents to access a field or two is not ideal and could cause performance issues... a better practice would be to access specific paths') is task-level best-practice framing that the pure reference pages (java-sdk kv-operations, cbsh docs) don't state in this form - the closest thing to a genuinely new, guide-specific contribution found in this batch, though it doesn't rise to needing a new concept id (it's advice about when to use an already-documented operation, mapped here via mustUseInsteadWhen). Repeats, verbatim, the same warning banner and related-links lists shared across creating-data.md, deleting-data.md, updating-data.md and bulk-operations.md.
